maddeler.e:
أندعس (form VII)
# أَنْدَعِسُ (ʔandaʕisu) /ʔan.da.ʕi.su/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِنْدَعَسَ (indaʕasa)
# أَنْدَعِسَ (ʔandaʕisa) /ʔan.da.ʕi.sa/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِنْدَعَسَ (indaʕasa)
# أَنْدَعِسْ (ʔandaʕis) /ʔan.da.ʕis/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِنْدَعَسَ (indaʕasa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
